rateSet: PENDING — the verified statutory rate set, entered by a human against current regulation
_readme: Statutory vectors (ADR-0018 §3): real published rates, real expected figures, verified
by a human against current Indonesian regulation. None is verified yet, so every entry
is status pending-verification with null input and expected: an assistant never types a
regulatory number — not a factor, not a bound, not an expected figure (ai-development-guide §5).
This quarantined list IS track 3's task list (implementation-roadmap §3): the statutory
advisor fills input and expected from the regulation's own worked figures, cites the exact
article in source, flips status to verified, and records the verification in the same
commit. The runner refuses a verified entry until the statutory rate set is wired, so
flipping a status without doing the work fails loudly rather than passing vacuously.
The pending count is printed by CI and blocks release promotion for the calculators the
release exposes (G20, ADR-0018 §5). It never blocks a merge.
⚠️ VERIFY: confirm against current Indonesian regulation before implementation.
